data.title: IT & AI solutions and corporate advisory.
data.hero_body: Expected methods produce nothing but expected results. Whatever sits inside the industry average, the domestic consensus, or the well-precedented option has already been claimed by someone else. From Singapore, we work across borders and sectors to reach the answers that lie outside the average.

copy.about_body_1: CAUCHYE is named after the Cauchy distribution. Named in turn for the 19th-century mathematician Augustin-Louis Cauchy, it has no expected value: however many samples you draw, the sample mean never converges, and the law of large numbers does not hold. It describes a world where the average is simply not a usable instrument.
copy.about_body_2: That is our starting point. Anything an average can settle has been settled already. What we take on sits outside it — AI implementations with little precedent, platforms that do not yet exist, and cross-border assets that no domestic benchmark describes. Results there cannot be predicted from the mean, which is precisely why they can exceed it.
copy.business_ai_body: From AI agent adoption and tailored solution development to our own product, we help teams start small and put AI to work in everyday operations.
copy.business_advisory_lead: Turn the market's view into decisions that build value.
copy.business_advisory_body: We connect capital-markets perception with management decisions through IR and shareholder relations, investor perception studies, capital allocation, portfolio review, and M&A evaluation.
copy.leader_bio: Born in Shiga, Japan. Graduated from the Faculty of Economics, Kyoto University, completed a master's programme at its Graduate School of Management, and researches AI in the doctoral programme in Social Informatics at its Graduate School of Informatics. As a white-hat hacker, he helped rescue crypto assets worth ¥500 million from a hack. He works on value creation for PE fund portfolio companies, including AI adoption, and is involved in structuring and managing FUKU Steel Plate Fund L.P., which leases steel plates to construction sites in Singapore.
copy.hero_cta_note: Starts with a 30-minute online call. Early-stage questions are welcome.
copy.hero_point_1: Start AI agent adoption small, with one workflow
copy.hero_point_2: Custom AI solutions, from development to operation
copy.hero_point_3: Corporate advisory, including IR/SR and capital strategy
copy.member_bio: Works across blockchain and AI. Contributes to the L1 blockchain "Sunrise" and the AI business-efficiency tool "D6E". Studied economics at Kyoto University.

data.title: IT・AIソリューションとコーポレートアドバイザリー。
data.hero_body: 期待どおりの手段からは、期待どおりの成果しか生まれません。業界の平均値、国内の常識、前例のある選択肢——その内側にある答えは、すでに誰かが手にしています。私たちはシンガポールを拠点に、国境と業種をまたぎながら、平均の外側にある解を取りに行きます。

copy.about_body_1: CAUCHYE という社名は、コーシー分布に由来します。19世紀の数学者オーギュスタン・ルイ・コーシーの名を冠したこの分布には、期待値が存在しません。標本をいくら増やしても標本平均は収束せず、大数の法則が成り立たない。平均という道具が、そもそも通用しない世界です。
copy.about_body_2: 私たちはそこを出発点にしています。平均で片のつく仕事は、すでに誰かが片をつけている。私たちが引き受けるのは、前例の乏しいAIの実装、まだ市場にない基盤の開発、そして国内の物差しでは測れないクロスボーダーの資産です。いずれも平均から結果を予測することはできません。だからこそ、平均を大きく超える余地があります。

copy.business_advisory_title: コーポレートアドバイザリー事業
copy.business_advisory_lead: 市場の声を、企業価値を高める意思決定へ。
copy.business_advisory_body: 資本市場からの見え方を捉え、企業価値を高める意思決定へ。IR・SR支援、投資家パーセプションスタディ、資本配分、M&Aの検討を一体で支援します。
copy.business_advisory_point_3: 資本配分・事業ポートフォリオ
copy.leader_bio: 滋賀県出身。京都大学経済学部卒業、同大学経営管理大学院修士課程修了、同大学情報学研究科社会情報学専攻博士後期課程でAIを研究。5億円分の暗号資産のハッキングを救ったホワイトハッカーとして活躍。PEファンドの投資先へのAI導入をはじめとしたバリューアップに携わっているほか、シンガポールの建設現場に敷鉄板をリースするファンド FUKU Steel Plate Fund L.P. の組成、運用にも携わっている。

data.title: AI Agent Adoption
data.description: Bring Codex, Claude Code, and Grok Bot into everyday work and build the practices needed for safe, sustained organizational adoption.
data.hero_body: We do more than distribute tools. We bring Codex, Claude Code, and Grok Bot into real workflows, help the organization operate with AI agents, and stay through measurable adoption. Start with one team and a small group of users.

copy.agent_organization_title: One person can direct a team of AI subordinates.
copy.agent_organization_development_body: An example structure where a person sets the objective for Codex, then Codex assigns research, implementation, and review to multiple Claude Code agents.
copy.agent_organization_operations_body: An example structure where a person works directly with a chief-of-staff Bot, an assistant Bot, and a research Bot to advance advice, coordination, and research in parallel.
copy.agent_tools_title: Use the right agent for the work.
copy.agent_tool_codex_body: Fit requirements work, implementation, testing, and review into the repositories and engineering workflows already in place.
copy.agent_tool_claude_body: Extend from large-codebase investigation and implementation into repeatable operations connected with internal systems.
copy.agent_tool_grok_body: Create a conversational entry point for delegating work to AI and extend adoption beyond engineering teams.
copy.agent_tool_grok_screen_alt: Official Grok Bot interface coordinating with multiple people
copy.agent_services_title: Support where you need it, from rollout through adoption.
copy.agent_service_1_body: Define the first workflows and users, then design the tools, accounts, access, and integrations. Using real work, we define what agents should handle and where people need to decide.
copy.agent_service_2_body: Reshape workflows, engineering practices, guidance, and evaluation so the organization can keep using and improving AI responsibly.
copy.agent_service_3_body: Set rules for confidential information, access control, logs, and review so adoption can expand safely.
copy.agent_service_4_body: Design practical programmes around real operating problems for executives, business teams, and engineers at different levels of experience.
copy.agent_fde_title: Practical AI implementation insights from FDE Mission
copy.agent_fde_body: Turn rapid changes in AI into knowledge teams can use. FDE Mission covers the latest developments through the lens of implementation and everyday operations.
copy.agent_cta_body: The first workflow does not need to be decided. Tell us how your team works today and where work is getting stuck.

data.title: AIエージェント導入支援
data.description: Codex、Claude Code、Grok Botを業務に組み込み、組織で安全に使い続けられる状態まで支援します。
data.hero_body: ツールを配って終わりにはしません。Codex、Claude Code、Grok Botを実際の業務に組み込み、組織をAIエージェント化し、成果が見える状態まで伴走します。まずは1部門・数名から始められます。

copy.agent_cta_primary: 導入について相談する
copy.agent_organization_title: 一人が、AI部下のチームを動かす。
copy.agent_organization_development_title: 開発を階層で委任する
copy.agent_organization_development_body: 人がCodexへ目的を伝え、Codexが複数のClaude Codeへ調査、実装、レビューを分担する構成例です。
copy.agent_organization_operations_body: 人が参謀Bot、秘書Bot、リサーチBotとそれぞれ直接やりとりし、相談、調整、調査を並行して進める構成例です。
copy.agent_tools_title: 業務に合わせて、エージェントを使い分ける。
copy.agent_tool_codex_body: 要件整理、実装、テスト、レビューを既存のリポジトリと開発フローに合わせて進めます。
copy.agent_tool_claude_body: 大規模なコードベースの調査や実装に加え、社内システムとつないだ定型業務の自動化へ広げます。
copy.agent_tool_grok_body: 普段使うチャットからAIへ仕事を依頼できる入口をつくり、エンジニア以外の部門にも活用を広げます。
copy.agent_tool_codex_screen_alt: Codexの公式プロダクト画面
copy.agent_tool_claude_screen_alt: Claude Codeの公式ターミナル画面
copy.agent_tool_grok_screen_alt: Grok Botが複数の相手へ確認する公式画面
copy.agent_services_title: 導入から定着まで、必要なところを支援。
copy.agent_service_1_title: 導入設計・ユースケース構築
copy.agent_service_1_body: 対象業務と利用者を整理し、ツール、アカウント、権限、接続先を設計。実際の業務を題材に、エージェントへ任せる範囲と人が判断するポイントを具体化します。
copy.agent_service_2_title: AIネイティブ組織開発支援
copy.agent_service_2_body: 業務設計、開発プロセス、ガイドライン、評価方法まで見直し、組織が継続的にAIを活用・改善できる状態をつくります。
copy.agent_service_3_title: セキュリティ・ガバナンス
copy.agent_service_3_body: 機密情報の範囲、アクセス制御、ログ、レビュー方法を整え、安全に展開できる基準をつくります。
copy.agent_service_4_title: AI活用研修・ワークショップ
copy.agent_service_4_body: 経営層、業務部門、エンジニアなど、役割と習熟度に合わせた実践型プログラムを設計。実際の業務課題を題材にします。
copy.agent_fde_title: AI実装の知見を発信する、FDE Mission
copy.agent_fde_body: AIの変化を、現場で使える知識に。最新動向を、実装と業務活用の視点から発信しています。

copy.agent_cta_body: 対象業務が決まっていない段階でも構いません。現在の業務と体制をお聞かせください。

data.title: AI Solution Development
data.description: Design and build AI agents, operational workflows, internal tools, and data foundations, integrated safely with existing systems.
data.hero_body: We design and build AI agents, operational workflows, data integrations, and internal tools, supporting the work from requirements through existing-system integration, production operations, and handover.

copy.ai_models_label: Work across leading AI models and platforms
copy.ai_models_note: We select models for the requirement and avoid unnecessary vendor lock-in. Marks shown indicate compatibility, not partnership or certification.
copy.ai_challenge_1: You want to use AI but cannot identify the right first workflow
copy.ai_challenge_2: A proof of concept works, but production and legacy integration remain blocked
copy.ai_challenge_3: ChatGPT or Claude is available, but adoption varies widely by team
copy.ai_challenge_4: Security and data-governance concerns prevent broader rollout
copy.ai_challenge_5: You want capability to remain in-house instead of outsourcing it indefinitely
copy.ai_services_title: One team from strategy to systems to production.
copy.development_vibe_title: Production readiness for internally vibe-coded tools
copy.development_vibe_body: Our security and operations specialists assess internal tools built by employees through vibe coding. We review and remediate code, dependencies, identity and access, and data handling, then take the tool through production deployment, monitoring, incident response, and ongoing maintenance.
copy.ai_service_1_body: A Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) works directly with your team to map workflows, evaluate value, feasibility, and risk, and turn the right priorities into an executable roadmap.
copy.ai_service_2_body: We design and build agents, data foundations, workflows, and internal tools, integrating them safely with systems already in place.
copy.ai_clients_title: Examples of the organizations we support
copy.ai_client_pe_body: We help private equity portfolio companies use AI to transform operations and improve profitability. From workflow discovery and priority setting through implementation and adoption, the work is designed to build enterprise value.
copy.ai_client_company_body: Starting from frontline work and existing systems, we combine AI implementation, security design, and production migration so the resulting systems can be operated continuously.
copy.ai_security_title: Security is a foundation, not an afterthought.
copy.ai_security_body: A security specialist with real incident-response experience participates from the design stage. That lets AI involving confidential data move beyond a proof of concept toward an architecture suitable for broader deployment.
copy.ai_security_point_2: Assessment of AI-specific attacks and data-exposure risks
copy.ai_security_point_3: Access control, auditability, and operating guidance
copy.ai_why_title: Working systems and internal capability remain after delivery.
copy.ai_why_point_1: Measure success through time saved and better decisions, not AI adoption itself
copy.ai_why_point_2: Move beyond a proof of concept to production connected with existing systems
copy.ai_why_point_3: Choose the right AI for each use case without forced model lock-in
copy.ai_why_point_4: Design for security, operations, and broader deployment from the beginning
copy.ai_why_point_5: Keep improving in-house through documentation and operational handover
copy.d6e_foundation_title: Turn accumulated experience into a shared foundation.
copy.d6e_foundation_body: CAUCHYE ASIA develops d6e, our own AI workflow foundation. Where the engagement calls for it, d6e accelerates integrations, access control, and operating design. We do not make d6e a prerequisite: the right architecture follows the security requirements, existing environment, operating model, and future options.
copy.d6e_foundation_point_1: Architectures deployable in the customer's environment
copy.d6e_foundation_point_2: Existing-system integration through APIs and MCP
copy.ai_faq_title: Questions we often hear before an engagement
copy.ai_cta_body: The problem does not need to be fully defined. Tell us how work happens today and what you want to change.

data.question: How do we choose the right AI agent?
data.answer: The fit depends on the workflow, existing environment, and data involved. We assess the current work and define the first agent and rollout scope.

data.question: Can non-engineering teams use AI agents?
data.answer: Yes. We can provide conversational entry points and workflow-specific guidance so people can use agents in everyday work without specialist knowledge.

data.question: Can we run a small trial before an organization-wide rollout?
data.answer: Yes. Start with one team and a small user group, measure the change in time and quality, and expand only when the value is clear.

data.question: どのAIエージェントを選べばよいか分かりません。
data.answer: 用途、既存環境、データの扱いによって向き不向きがあります。現在の業務を伺い、最初に試すエージェントと範囲を整理します。

data.question: エンジニアがいない部門でも利用できますか？
data.answer: 利用できます。チャットから使える入口や業務別の使い方を用意し、専門知識がなくても日常業務で活用できる状態をつくります。

data.question: 全社導入の前に小さく試せますか？
data.answer: はい。1部門・数名から始め、業務時間や品質の変化を確認したうえで、導入範囲を広げられます。

data.question: Can we talk before there is a defined development project?
data.answer: Yes. We can begin with workflow mapping and an AI opportunity assessment, clarifying the objective, available data, constraints, and the smallest useful validation.

data.question: Can you work with tools we already use, such as ChatGPT or Claude?
data.answer: Yes. We design around existing contracts and cloud environments where appropriate. No specific model or CAUCHYE platform is mandatory.

data.question: Can you support adoption inside the organization as well as development?
data.answer: Yes. We can design usage guidance, role-specific training, workshops based on real work, and the review practices needed for sustained adoption.

data.question: まだ具体的な開発案件になっていなくても相談できますか？
data.answer: はい。対象業務の整理やAI適用診断からご一緒できます。目的、現状の業務、利用できるデータ、制約を伺い、最初に検証すべき範囲を整理します。

data.question: ChatGPTやClaudeなど、すでに導入しているツールを活かせますか？
data.answer: はい。既存契約やクラウド環境を前提に構成を検討します。特定のモデルや自社基盤の利用を必須にはしません。

data.question: 開発だけでなく、社内への定着も支援できますか？
data.answer: 可能です。利用ガイドライン、役割別研修、実業務を題材にしたワークショップ、レビュー体制の設計まで支援します。
